appearance_source: Original P16 walking sprites, consistent with pet.jpg and original three-view reference
video_role: Gait phase timing/support/recovery only; no video dog images were supplied to image generation

prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve.
EDIT TARGET Image1 WalkLeft-appearance-edit-target.png: eight copies of the SAME EXISTING desktop pet. This character is FIXED. Image2 is a simplified motion-only joint diagram, not an appearance reference.
Change ONLY the four legs/paws below the shoulders and hips in each cell of Image1 to produce the eight walk phases in Image2. Preserve the original pet's head, FACE ANGLE, face expression with happy open mouth and little pink tongue, large round dome, long fluffy floppy ear hair, small black nose, round dark eyes, exact head-to-body proportion, fluffy curled round pompom tail, short compact torso, white curled fur texture, red floral collar and golden bell. The original dog's face is three-quarter toward the viewer while facing LEFT. Do not turn it into a pure side profile. Do not make a new dog, smaller head, longer back, thin ears, smooth short-haired body, taller legs or elongated muzzle. Upper body/face/tail should visually match Image1 throughout ALL frames.
8 cells chronological top0,1,2,3 bottom4,5,6,7. Legs only: nearest hind leg supports then follows ground backwards through phases0-3; phase4 paw leaves ground behind hip; phase5 knee folds forward under belly with low clearance; phase6 paw lands forward; phase7 starts grounded return. Nearest foreleg reaches and lands0, retreats1-3, bends/recovers4-6, reaches again7. Far legs offset by half cycle, support the body while nearest leg swings, anatomically occluded behind body where appropriate. DIAGRAM joints are motion direction hints, not long exposed sticklike legs. Use original compact fluffy bichon leg length, keep canine knee/hock bend and tiny paw lift. Fur covers joints naturally.
Head/ears/tail/torso/collar remain almost frozen at their original appearance/scale/location; the moving legs carry the animation. No upper-body yaw, head bob, camera angle or tail shape changes. Do not hold hind legs static while moving forelegs.
Exactly4columns x2rows,1536x1024RGBA transparent sprite atlas. Each dog entirely in its own384x512cell, same scale with at least30pixels empty gutter. Maintain original white fur and true alpha outside the eight silhouettes. No text, diagrams, colored lines, floor, shadows or background. Only the input pet, with varied leg poses. If appearance and motion instructions conflict, original appearance takes precedence.
Additional invariant: keep the exact original left-facing face, cheek shape and long ear hair from Image1, same happy mouth and tongue. All eight heads must retain that precise three-quarter angle. Preserve fluffy rounded tail rather than an upright hook. Do not mirror another newly designed dog; edit only the legs of this existing left-facing pet.
